notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: If the domain of the function $f(x)=\sqrt{\log_{(0.6)}\left(\left|\frac{2x-5}{x^2-4}\right|\right)}$ is $(-\infty,a] \cup \{b\} \cup [c,d) \cup (e,\infty)$, then the value of $a+b+c+d+e$ is ______.
stem.hi: यदि फलन $f(x)=\sqrt{\log_{(0.6)}\left(\left|\frac{2x-5}{x^2-4}\right|\right)}$ का प्रांत $(-\infty,a] \cup \{b\} \cup [c,d) \cup (e,\infty)$ है, तो $a+b+c+d+e$ का मान ______ है।

feynman.en: A logarithm to a base below $1$ is non-negative exactly when its argument lies in $(0,1]$. So we need $0<\left|\frac{2x-5}{x^2-4}\right|\le1$.
feynman.hi: $1$ से छोटे आधार वाला लघुगणक तभी अऋणात्मक है जब उसका तर्क $(0,1]$ में हो। अतः $0<\left|\frac{2x-5}{x^2-4}\right|\le1$ चाहिए।
